comment: The YouTube Data API key used to fetch video details when adding product videos.
modal: The API key the admin uses to call the YouTube Data API when retrieving metadata for product videos hosted on YouTube. Obtain it from the Google API console.

comment: Whether a product's base video plays automatically on the product page.
modal: When **Yes**, the video marked as the product's base media starts playing automatically on the product page. Can be set per website or store view.

comment: Whether related videos are shown when a product video ends.
modal: When **Yes**, related videos are displayed after a product video finishes playing. Can be set per website or store view.

comment: Whether a product video restarts automatically after it finishes.
modal: When **Yes**, a product video loops, restarting automatically once it reaches the end. Can be set per website or store view.
